primary_frame: Assess whether employee features reliably predict performance rating
alternative_frames: Identify which employee attributes most influence performance rating
Segment employees by performance drivers such as experience and training
Evaluate whether satisfaction score is associated with performance rating
required_checks: Test pairwise correlations between numeric features and performance_rating
Check for non-linear relationships between features and performance_rating
Verify that salary_band groups differ meaningfully in performance_rating
Assess overall model fit and warn if no feature is predictive
Check for multicollinearity among predictor features
framing_risks: No target variable is explicitly specified; performance_rating is assumed based on column semantics
Data may contain no genuine signal if features are independently generated noise
satisfaction_score could alternatively serve as the target variable
Uniform-looking feature distributions may indicate synthetic or randomly generated data
